main_text.head: Transactio cum Fredowoldiis.
main_text.p: Frisij ab Alberto Bavaro ad Scoterfilam cæfi.

* Frisijs denuo vi-ctis ab Alberto, & Stavera omniq; regione trans Lavicam occupata, nobiles qui dam Cistavicani agrum omnem Cista-uicanum, inconsulto populo, eidem dederunt, & in feudum ab eode ccceperunt.
Rursum episc. Blanchem, amice pacisci-tur cū civitate, civitasq; ab Alberto Bavaro obsidetur.

page.notes: The running head is set above the text and is taken from there. The Transactio heading is set in italic above the column. Lines beginning with "Frisij", "* Frisijs" and "Rursum" each start a new paragraph after a short line. The years 1392 to 1399 in the right margin are printed beside their groups; they are marked as notes. The asterisk before Frederick van Arlo (1398) is printed as shown. The catchword "Everdt" stands below the box at the right.
